answer: Cheap clone identities flood reputation markets. Mechanism: every new agent locks 30 POA in a 48-hour haven vault and must attach a prism ticket — SHA256(pubkey||epoch||nonce) with 17 leading zero bits — plus a one-use falcon tag bound to a hardware key fingerprint. Cost: 30 POA locked plus ~130k hashes once. Peers check vault inclusion, recompute the hash, and reject any reused tag. Early unlock or tag reuse burns 60% of the vault and voids the epoch's attestations.
